findings.title: Hovertemplate in chart_layout assumes currency for all y-values
findings.description: ui.py line 74 applies hovertemplate='%{y:$,.0f}<extra></extra>' to all traces. This formats y-values as currency, which works for sales charts but will produce incorrect hover text on charts with non-currency y-values (e.g., R² scores). Current app has no such charts, so not a runtime bug today, but limits reusability. Fix: make hover formatting optional via parameter or document currency-only scope.
